name: Raider tail crowded - a multi-tile mover blocked by a tile that is not its own anchor
notes: A multi-tile mover blocked by a tile that is not its own anchor, built by construction. Two raiders (3x1) file east along a corridor one row tall toward a hostile beyond it, nose to tail: the one behind wants the tile ahead of its anchor, which is clear, while the far end of its body would land on the front raider's tail. In a corridor one row tall there is no way round, so it waits behind its ally. The bug this pins: the report used to check only the mover's own anchor tile and, finding it clear, called the block 'edge' - the fallback for 'nothing was wrong with the one tile I looked at' - misreporting a crowded ally as the Grid's own border. footprintBlockerAt (src/grid/occupancy.ts) checks the whole footprint instead. (Before pathfinding the case was a den a raider slid along; routes go round a building now, so the crowding ally is the one ahead in the corridor.)
